name: ncnn (Tencent)
notable_features: ncnn is a high-performance neural network inference framework optimized for mobile platforms
Uses its own model format converted from ONNX/Caffe via ncnn2onnx and onnx2ncnn tools
Vulkan GPU acceleration on Android - the primary GPU backend
ARM NEON CPU optimization for mobile processors
No dependencies beyond Vulkan - extremely small binary footprint
Battle-tested by Tencent in consumer products (WeChat, QQ, etc.)
hardware_caveats: Closed model format - .ncnn is proprietary, converted from ONNX/Caffe
No GGUF, safetensors, or direct PyTorch support - conversion required
Vulkan-only GPU backend - no CUDA, Metal, or OpenCL on iOS
No continuous batching or paged KV cache - single-stream inference only
LLM support is limited - primarily designed for vision and small models
No iOS GPU acceleration - Vulkan is Android-only
best_for: Android apps requiring Vulkan GPU acceleration with minimal dependencies
Mobile vision models (detection, segmentation, face recognition)
Embedded Linux devices with Vulkan support
Applications where binary footprint is critical
avoid_for: iOS deployment - no Metal backend, Vulkan is Android-only
Large language models - not optimized for LLM inference
CUDA or ROCm hardware - no desktop GPU support
High-concurrency serving - no batching or scheduling support
notes: ncnn is Tencent's mobile inference framework, optimized for Android with Vulkan GPU acceleration. It is distinct from MNN (Alibaba) in that it uses Vulkan as its primary GPU backend rather than OpenCL. For local LLM inference, ncnn is not the primary choice - it is optimized for vision and small models.
